approval_scope: Proposed SOURCE/ENCODING ledger binding integrity, evidence provenance, carry-forward scope and exact source-page completion membership only. Final export acceptance and full-batch promotion are excluded.

reviewer.setting: Exact deployed variant and reasoning setting are not exposed.
reviewer.method: Read proposal and evidence scopes, inspected selected new/old records, independently checked all429 hashes/history/flags,30 non-global delta records and reconstructed source-page memberships. Historical nested source adjudications were preserved rather than re-reviewed.

checks.current_payload_hashes: All429 match exact supplied current payload under actual review.reading_hash: SHA256(UTF-8 whitespace-collapsed NFKD text). Manifest and proposed final_sha256 agree.
checks.assembled_snapshot: Proposal readings_sha256 matches exact current assembled-complete-draft-readings.json.
checks.old_records: All unchanged old records equal baseline objects exactly. All300 replaced records retain complete baseline previous_review plus original primary/independent reader hashes.
checks.new_reader_hashes: All129 new keys reproduce primary-frozen.json byte hash and SHA256 of blind-346.json UTF-8 text concatenated directly with blind-351.json UTF-8 text, no extra separator. Exact paths and algorithm are now explicit in new records. These are artifact identifiers, not new per-unit blind transcription claims.
checks.model_provenance: Blind artifacts identify claude-opus-5-5; invocation metadata confirms configured medium effort. Codex/GPT-6 primary label is consistent with known family; no exact Codex deployment/setting is invented.
checks.evidence_chain: Cited hashes match current artifacts. Initial closing-encoding-review approved=false is superseded only through closing-remedy-review approved=true and final registry remedy/generated proof plus actual-reference closure; it is not treated as standalone approval. Independent full order and seasonal closure cover the changed global sequence scopes.
checks.non_global_old_deltas: 30 records add reviewed canonical/printing variants, attesting controls/corrections and structural realization metadata. All5 records with changed unit payload retain NFKD/whitespace-equivalent literal main-printing words. rh_avodah HE/EN resolved source-fidelity hashes remain identical. New printing readings are covered by closing source/human closure and complete changed-module review; earlier source acceptance is carried forward only for unchanged earlier words.
checks.editorial_controls: New editorial Modim reader description is identifiable as editorial with no source scan; binding indicates reviewed applicability/encoding, not a claim that a blind reader saw it printed.
checks.export_gate: All429 changed records retain export_qa_complete=false and explicitly say final exports pending. Nested historical export acceptance is retained as history, not applied to changed output.

completion_membership.method: Reconstructed from unit fragments, citations, documentary opening scans and all continuation source_pages, front-page records and encoding-key scan memberships; compared exact sorted key lists.
completion_membership.scope: New membership keys on old leaves are reused accepted provider/encoding coverage, not newly claimed source words. New346–355 completion is source/encoding only; no export promotion.

evidence_scope_limitations: Registry actual-reference closure checks the last two reference fields and relies on prior full registry review for other records; this audit does not invent a fresh independent review of all139.
Module/guideline and source conclusions are inherited from their actual independent reviews and human closure; this is binding audit, not a new source or TEI adjudication.
All prior HTML/season/source/order approvals retain their original limits.
Final PDFs, final export QA, whole-batch promotion and publication remain outside this approval.
